say:2:1222301001:1.text: Hi, Leonor! Is something bothering you? You look pretty upset.
say:2:1222301001:1.source_cn: 你好啊，莱诺曼！又出什么事了吗？你看起来好像很不高兴。

say:3:1222301002:1.text: Oh, don't even get me started. The expert I'm shadowing was suddenly inspired to write a research paper on the fish in Rustport. I have to collect all the local fish species for him.
say:3:1222301002:1.source_cn: 别提了。我跟随的那位专家突发奇想，要写一篇锈锚港鱼类研...

say:4:1222301003:1.text: All! Including those who live around tropical islands! I can't go out to sea to catch them, and no one's selling them either. Don't you think he's trying to make things difficult for me...
say:4:1222301003:1.source_cn: ——所有鱼类！包括生活在热带海岛上的那些！可我既不能出...

choice_prompt:5:1222301003.text: All! Including those who live around tropical islands! I can't go out to sea to catch them, and no one's selling them either. Don't you think he's trying to make things difficult for me...
choice_prompt:5:1222301003.source_cn: ——所有鱼类！包括生活在热带海岛上的那些！可我既不能出海，买也买不到，这不是刁难人吗……

say:6:1222301004:1.source_cn: 真的可以吗？那就多谢了！

say:7:1222301007:1.text: Just like last time, the expert has given me a list.
say:7:1222301007:1.source_cn: 和之前一样，这次专家也给了我一份鱼类清单。

say:8:1222301008:1.text: <style="highlight">Rainbow snapper</style>, <style="highlight">reef trout</style>, and <style="highlight">lampeye fish</style>. These three species will do.

say:9:1222301009:1.text: Of course, it has to be <style="highlight">live fish</style>!

choice:5:0:1.text: I can keep an eye out for you.
choice:5:0:1.male: I can keep an eye out for you.
choice:5:0:1.female: I can keep an eye out for you.

say:11:1222301005:1.text: Actually, we haven't been able to recruit many members yet...
say:11:1222301005:1.source_cn: 呃，实话实说，协会还没招募到几个成员……

say:12:1222301006:1.text: It'd be great if you're willing to help!
say:12:1222301006:1.source_cn: 如果你们愿意帮忙的话，就再好不过了！

choice:5:1:2.text: Why don't you get help from the fishermen in the society?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 钓鱼协会里的捕鱼人不肯帮你吗？
choice:5:1:2.male: Why don't you get help from the fishermen in the society?
choice:5:1:2.female: Why don't you get help from the fishermen in the society?

say:0:1222302001:0.text: Impressive, Magister! You've caught all the tropical fish Leonor needs so quickly! Let's give the fish to her.
say:0:1222302001:0.source_cn: 不愧是主人，这么快就收集到了莱诺曼小姐需要的热带鱼！赶...
say:0:1222302001:0.male: Impressive, Magister! You've caught all the tropical fish Leonor needs so quickly! Let's give the fish to her.
say:0:1222302001:0.female: Impressive, Magister! You've caught all the tropical fish Leonor needs so quickly! Let's give the fish to her.

say:1:1222303001:1.text: Where on earth can I get tropical fish... Huh? You've got them all?!
say:1:1222303001:1.source_cn: 上哪找热带鱼……咦，你全都找回来了？！
say:1:1222303001:1.male: Where on earth can I get tropical fish... Huh? You've got them all?!
say:1:1222303001:1.female: Where on earth can I get tropical fish... Huh? You've got them all?!

say:2:1222303002:1.text: Dura above, I never thought you'd catch me the fish yourselves!
say:2:1222303002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我以为你只会帮忙找找线索，没想到你居然亲自出...
say:2:1222303002:1.male: Dura above, I never thought you'd catch me the fish yourselves!
say:2:1222303002:1.female: Dura above, I never thought you'd catch me the fish yourselves!

say:3:1222303003:1.text: Thanks a lot! I can finally wrap things up now!
say:3:1222303003:1.source_cn: 多谢你啦，这下我总算可以交差了！
say:3:1222303003:1.male: Thanks a lot! I can finally wrap things up now!
say:3:1222303003:1.female: Thanks a lot! I can finally wrap things up now!
